# Corrected Weynants et al. hydraulic-parameter pedotransfer function.

## Source

Weynants, M., Vereecken, H., & Javaux, M. (2009). Revisiting Vereecken pedotransfer functions: Introducing a closed-form hydraulic model. Vadose Zone Journal, 8(1), 86-95.

[DOI: 10.2136/vzj2008.0062](https://doi.org/10.2136/vzj2008.0062)

## Functions

### `calc_ptf_weynants2009`

Estimate six van Genuchten-Mualem hydraulic parameters from texture, bulk density, and organic carbon.

**Status:** `implemented`

**Prediction target:** Residual and saturated volumetric water content, van Genuchten alpha and n, matrix matching-point conductivity, and the Mualem pore-connectivity parameter.

**Models:** $h(\theta)$ — van Genuchten retention model with m = 1 - 1/n; $k(h)$ — Mualem conductivity model with matrix matching-point K0 and pore-connectivity parameter tau

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Unit | Domain | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `clay` | `number` | % | 0 <= value <= 100 | Particles smaller than 2 micrometres as a mass percentage of fine earth. |
| `sand` | `number` | % | 0 <= value <= 100 | Particles from 0.05 to 2 millimetres as a mass percentage of fine earth. |
| `bulk_density` | `number` | g/cm^3 | — | Dry bulk density; values in g/cm^3 are numerically equal to values in Mg/m^3. |
| `organic_carbon` | `number` | % | 0 <= value <= 100 | Organic carbon as a percentage by mass, following the mandatory 2017 erratum. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Unit | Domain | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `theta_r` | m3/m3 | value = 0 | Residual volumetric soil water content fixed at zero. |
| `theta_s` | m3/m3 | — | Saturated volumetric soil water content. |
| `alpha` | cm^-1 | value > 0 | Inverse pressure-scale parameter of the van Genuchten model. |
| `n` | dimensionless | value > 1 | Pore-size distribution parameter of the van Genuchten model. |
| `k0` | cm/day | value > 0 | Matrix matching-point hydraulic conductivity at zero pressure head. |
| `tau` | dimensionless | — | Mualem pore-connectivity and tortuosity parameter. |

!!! note

    K0 is the matrix matching-point conductivity at zero pressure head, not measured macropore-influenced saturated conductivity.

!!! note

    The software evaluates the equations without input guards, texture-sum checks, output clamps, or out-of-domain errors.

!!! warning

    Supply organic carbon in percent by mass, not in the g/kg unit printed in the original 2009 table.

!!! warning

    The corrected training ranges are sand 5.60-97.80%, clay 0-54.50%, bulk density 0.89-1.77 g/cm^3, and organic carbon 0.01-6.60%; these are marginal ranges rather than a joint applicability hull.

!!! warning

    The fitted conductivity model is unsuitable for prediction at pressure heads greater than -6 cm because observations with absolute pressure head below 6 cm were excluded.
